Subject: Birchley Home & Garden - Referral Required

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the Birchley Home & Garden submission. I've reviewed the information and have everything I need from a documentation standpoint.

However, this risk requires referral to our senior underwriting team due to coastal exposure concerns. Specifically, 2 locations fall within 16 km of the coast, and we're already carrying significant concentration in that area (high total insured values within 25 km).

Given our current portfolio position, this may be challenging for us to quote competitively. I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty coastal property market that can better accommodate this exposure—they'll likely provide more favorable terms.

I'm happy to discuss further if you'd like, but wanted to set expectations early.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
